verdict.rationale: Productboard's Webhooks API lets you subscribe to events and receive real-time notifications when data changes, which is a basic event-trigger mechanism, but there is no evidence of a native rules/automation engine where users define conditional actions (e.g., 'if X then update Y') inside Productboard itself. Missing for 10: documented rule-builder or automation engine, evidence of actions being executed automatically (not just notifications), and examples of chained trigger-action workflows.
